text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with No Reason...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Look, an adorable doll is over there!
It's looking right this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction No Reason pointed, there was a crane game filled with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I like it!
I'm gonna make that mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No Reason challenged the crane game, but the claw failed to grasp the Paka Petit plush, ending in a clean miss.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gnugh...! My opponent's pretty skilled too, hm.
Slipping past all my attacks with ease.
choice_data_list: Want me to get it for you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? So you have a plan!
As expected of my strategist! Most dependable!
choice_data_list: No, it's not really that big of a deal...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Is that modesty? Or is it a case of deceiving your allies first to deceive your enemy? My expectations are soaring!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come, Strategist, to the battlefield we ride!
Let us strike down the Paka Puchi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
